location_and_environment: Base of the crane and the bonfire pit area near Block 99 — a dug-out hollow stacked with wood, lacking only a flame source. First evening on campus.

characters_present.name: Serra Vox
characters_present.status: NPC — invited the party to 'Bonfire tonight'; nervous, anthropology-minded, no diplomacy books exist for this; identified the clan folk by clothing and fire

characters_present.name: Britt
characters_present.status: pivoted from shaking the crane to confronting Serra; then apologized for coming off aggressive — growth beat

characters_present.name: Aggie
characters_present.status: smoothly covered for Britt ('don't mind my cousin'); shook Serra's hand

characters_present.name: Ignatius
characters_present.status: doesn't trust Serra; volunteered nothing; is quietly the obvious solution to the fireless bonfire

characters_present.name: Iggy
characters_present.status: slid down the scaffolding entire; invited to a 'bonfire bar'; now present in the group

characters_present.name: Lomi
characters_present.status: found Block 99 by following steam stacks; inspecting the fire pit; about to solve the flame problem

immediate_preceding_action: Lomi offered to solve the bonfire's flame problem; the whole party is now gathered at the pit with Serra Vox — session ends on this hook. Next session opens with the nighttime bonfire activity.
emotional_tone_or_tension: Warm gathering tension — strangers testing each other, an invitation extended, and a small dramatic question (how does a party containing a fire-man light a fire?) left hanging.
